<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1170
Claimant:
Gabriela Watkins
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
15 Jul 2025
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a stop and said the other vehicle struck them from behind while they
were stopped in traffic. Initial intake recorded neck and back strain as the injuries described.
6 Oct 2025
The claimant's account of the crash has stayed the same in every conversation so far, including the sequence of
events and the position of both vehicles. The driver is named on the policy, and coverage was in force at the time of
loss.
13 Oct 2025
Police and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the impact occurred as
described. The other driver has also given a statement that matches the claimant's version.
14 Nov 2025
Photos from the scene show rear-end damage that lines up well with the described impact. Repair estimates for the
vehicle follow the same damage pattern, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior
claims search.
22 Dec 2025
The reported neck and back strain fits the kind and force of a rear impact of this type. Medical records show no earlier
injury to the same body areas.
25 Dec 2025
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with follow-up visits spread over several
weeks. The treating provider has documented ongoing symptoms and a plan for physical therapy.
4 Jan 2026
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the policy coverage began. The effective date and
the loss timeline remain consistent across the policy records and the claim intake.
1 Feb 2026
The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative with requests for records and a recorded
statement. No contact from outside representation has been received to date.
4 Feb 2026
Based on the current file, the claim is progressing normally, and the bodily injury evaluation will continue once the
final treatment records are received. Next steps are to obtain the outstanding imaging reports and schedule a
follow-up with the claimant.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
